title.narrative: Activity under preparation EU Mobility Programme for Myanmar (Phase II) (EMPM II)

description.narrative: EMPM is at the core of EU's political and programmatic priorities in supporting Myanmar¿ people and in particular its young generations by enhancing access to quality education and training. It intends to provide scholarships for higher education and training opportunities for Myanmar¿s students and young professionals, to create a cadre of informed and globally educated Myanmar future decision-makers and leading professionals, with strong ties to Europe and ASEAN.The action will maintain the high visibility and positive image won by the EU through the original EU Mobility Programme for Myanmar (EMPM) project.The initiative intends to: i) Expand access to higher education and training with a particular emphasis on significantly improving individual competences, skills and qualifications across various academic disciplines that boost economic participation. This initiative empowers Myanmar youth to make significant contributions to their communities and society at large to ; ii) Facilitate student and academic mobility, giving access to internationally recognized degrees and qualifications, and fostering lasting connections of these students with peers in the EU and ASEAN. This will establish the foundation for long-term people-to-people partnerships with future leaders, contributing to breaking the isolation of Myanmar¿s youth and allowing them to grow into leadership roles in sustainable development and economic growth, and allowing them to be the link between the Myanmar people, ASEAN, the EU, and the global community.EMPM (Phase 2) is designed as an instrument of European public diplomacy in Myanmar and the wider ASEAN region, aiming to forge relationships based on trust and esteem. By deepening knowledge of the European Union, its institutions, and ASEAN among Myanmar¿s future leaders and their ASEAN peers, EMPM (Phase 2) seeks to cultivate lasting friendships and social capital that will strengthen EU-Myanmar-ASEAN ties across generations.
